scope: Independent semantic QA of the P0 Stack pilot after author rework round 2

findings.observed: All five briefs repeat the same generic three-case template. The text mentions enough space/data, empty/full/one-item/one-free-slot, and a failed guard or one-sided transaction regardless of pattern. In STACK_SETUP and STACK_REDUCE, several phrases are semantically inapplicable; in the other briefs the template does not identify the exact state transition that Stage 7 must storyboard.

expected_correction_semantics.p0.stack.visual.stack-setup: Specify the two empty-state convention snapshots as the normal comparison; capacity 1 and required-versus-unspecified cell initialisation as boundaries; mixed convention/capacity-index mismatch as the failure demonstration.
expected_correction_semantics.p0.stack.visual.stack-push: Specify a successful Push under both top conventions; one-free-slot and full boundaries; a full call that preserves every cell/top plus wrong update order/result contract as failure demonstrations.
expected_correction_semantics.p0.stack.visual.stack-pop: Specify a successful Pop from two distinct items; one-item and empty boundaries under both conventions; exact sentinel plus unchanged empty state and wrong-read-index as failure demonstrations.
expected_correction_semantics.p0.stack.visual.stack-pair: Specify both-live commit; both one-sided-empty rollback cases; both-empty no-restore/no-mutation/no-sentinel case with the AlgoCore-inference message boundary.
expected_correction_semantics.p0.stack.visual.stack-reduce: Specify a multi-pair non-commutative left fold and a mixed extrema scan; single-value, one complete operator-number pair and all-negative boundaries; reversed operands, sentinel-as-data and malformed-input-outside-source-contract distinctions as counterexamples/failure handling.
expected_correction_semantics.parity: Replace each affected field in both Vietnamese and English with matching meaning. Do not change status from PENDING_STAGE5_TRACE_AND_STAGE7_STORYBOARD or add trace/run claims.

findings.acceptance_test: The five (normal_case, boundary_case, failure_case) triples are pattern-specific, VI/EN-complete, consistent with each card/error/example, and no longer duplicate a shared generic triple.
findings.closure_evidence: VISUAL_BRIEFS.json sha256 ca38a8d009a3b0cc3f51f8cdc051d55a3a6071383fe845345e71e6b22a2614cd supplies distinct concrete case triples for all five patterns; independent validator semantic.visual_cases_pattern_specific now passes.

closed_observations.detail: Rework round 2 records current S4-S2/S4-S3 hashes in all six generated artifacts; independent recomputation found zero drift.
S4-S2-LAYOUT-CODE-FIDELITY no longer appears in generated source_issue_refs. S4-S2-POLICY-LAYOUT-CODE-FIDELITY is explicitly is_source_issue=false.
The seven 9618_s25_42_1(e) atoms now match the live resubmission: explicit value 1 on all seven, mp.05 discrete, and continuation dependencies preserved.

Rework round 2 removes pending-adjudication wording. The four-case decision commits both successes, restores exactly the sole successful item, and treats both-empty as no restore/no mutation/no sentinel under AlgoCore_inference.

Top-pointer equations and mutation order, Push/Pop guards, reduction operand order/termination, authority labels, VI/EN parity, Stage 5 solution boundary, Stage 7 visual boundary, and absence of executable/run claims all passed independent checks.
